stories.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured response schema for travel including origin_type (user_zip|lat_lng), normalized origin coordinates, destination (site address/lat_lng), distance_miles, duration_minutes, route_status (OK|UNAVAILABLE), and error_code. Ensure compatibility with existing clinical_trials_models and deterministic null handling for missing inputs.

stories.title: Implement Travel Distance and Time Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic using Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration between normalized user origin (zip→lat/lng or direct lat/lng) and each clinical trial site. Include unit normalization, timeout handling, and deterministic fallback (route_status=UNAVAILABLE with null metrics) for API errors or incomplete location data.

stories.title: Integrate Travel Burden into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose travel distance and duration through evaluate_care_facade, attaching travel metrics to each trial location. Ensure compatibility with tool_router allowlist and clinical_trials_models so outputs are consumable by chat responses without schema drift.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden Computation
stories.description: Create unit tests for travel computation including edge cases (invalid zip, missing coordinates, API failures, timeouts) and contract validation tests for schema compliance. Add integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade through service with mocked Google Routes responses.

stories.title: Optimize Google Routes API Usage for Multi-Location Trials
stories.description: Implement efficient handling for multiple trial locations including sequential batching, rate-limit backoff, and lightweight TTL caching per origin-destination pair to reduce redundant API calls while preserving deterministic outputs.
